title: Ch’amakt’at Uma Lakankir Arunaka
intro: Mä ayllun sutip amuyt’añäni, janiw mä markatakis jan ukax mä apnaqiritakis sutinchatäkiti, jan ukasti jakañax tantachasiwayki uka ch’ama umatakiw sutinchata. Mä qawqha jisk’a t’aqanakakiw aka ayllun amtasi, sapa kutiw khitinakatix irnaqäw jan iyawsapki ukanakamp chika qillqt’ata. Chʼamakat parlapki uk istʼapjjam.
clues: Jiwasax Quran ukan sutip uñt’at comunidad ukhamätanwa, ukampirus taqpach sarnaqäwisax misterio ukan velo ukamp ch’uqt’ataw qhiparaski.
Jiwasax khitinakatix jan iyawsapkän ukanakamp chikaw arsusipxistu, Ad ukat Thamud markankirinakjama.
Jiwasax Compañeros de Ar-Rass satawa, uka phuch’uruw jakäwisax chint’ata.
Qhana irpamp khithanipkäna uka yatiyiriruw jan iyaw sapkti.
Jiwasax khitinakatix taqi khithatanakar jan iyawsapkän ukanakamp chikaw jakthapitanxa.
Jiwasan nayraqatasan sapa jan iyawsirinakar phuqhat amenazampiw atipjayasipxta, jan iyawsäwisat t’unjañataki.

arabic: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
verse: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubbaʿ. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled. (50:14)
